estimand: ITT difference in probability of an authorized, actually transferred, validated novel contribution within proposed90days, comparing verified-protected offer to locality-only among pre-assignment consenting eligible institutions. Secondary secure-aggregate contrast is separate.
selection: Define sampling frame and eligibility before assignment; obtain study consent before randomization. Report nonconsent/refusal and limits of generalizing beyond consenting institutions. Baseline authorized access/novelty inventory is fixed pre-offer.
assignment: Stratified institution-level randomization by sector, size and baseline access readiness; record assignment probability and deviations. Three bundled offers identify bundle effects, not isolated privacy/verification mechanisms.
attrition: Keep assigned denominators and reasons for refusal/withdrawal/cost. Distinguish known zero contributions from missing follow-up; report missingness bounds and sensitivity, not completer-only effects.
interference: Shared governance, cross-institution collaboration and public offers can contaminate assignment; predefine clusters/network exposure and sensitivity analysis.
offer_review: Each offer must specify actual versioned roles, views, costs, authorized release and supported guarantees. Do not promise unproved ZK/DP. Independent study/protocol/privacy and institutional approvals precede recruitment.
sample_size: pending-feasibility-and-power-analysis; no institutions recruited or hypothetical willingness counted
generative_data: Novel generated-data utility and beneficiary outcomes require distinct validation; remain hypotheses.
